summary_md: Aviation services dominate today’s batch with consolidation and restructuring in focus: SNCY’s agreed acquisition by Allegiant shifts the story to merger arbitrage, FLYX closed an all-equity deal for Jet.AI assets including a SpaceX-linked stake, and SOAR is seeking a merger while battling soaring short interest even as its Vaunt membership platform grows. SRFM is restructuring debt and monetizing aviation software through Palantir and Wheels Up deals. A parallel theme is unconventional digital-asset pivots—GNLN abandoned its legacy business to hold BERA tokens, SCLX launched a meme coin, and MIRA’s ticker blends an early-stage pharma asset with a deflated crypto token. Housing softness weighs on BXC, LIVE’s flooring segment, and TITN, though HVT is gaining share with affluent consumers. Capital returns and balance-sheet repair are common: MKTW and VALU raised dividends and buybacks, while SOAR and SRFM cut convertible debt.
